get_user_profile.title: Get the signed-in customer's profile
get_user_profile.description: Return the Amazon customer profile behind this Login with Amazon connection: user_id always; name and email with the profile scope; postal_code (when the customer has one) with the postal_code scope. A token granted only profile:user_id gets user_id alone. Use it to identify or greet the connected customer.
get_user_profile.notes: Fields returned follow the scopes granted at sign-in: profile -> user_id, name, email; profile:user_id -> user_id; postal_code -> postal_code.

user_id.description: Unique, stable customer identifier for this app.
